title: zostera latifolia
intro: Zostera latifolia, commonly known as eelgrass, is a type of marine angiosperm that belongs to the family Zosteraceae. Eelgrass is a long-lived, perennial seagrass that provides essential ecosystem services such as coastal stabilization, nursery habitat for juvenile fish, and carbon sequestration. The health benefits of eelgrass are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of eelgrass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
